title: sideroxylon politum
intro: Sideroxylon politum, commonly known as the Black Olive Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant.
